notes:
CRM notes: mid-market product analytics vendor. Primary goal: improve customer support automation and search relevancy across Docs + KB. Tried Hosted API for quick validation — team liked latency but wants predictable throughput and isolated data.

POC scope: 4-week Dedicated POC. Key goals: 1) validate canary rollout to 10% of traffic, 2) exercise fallback routing (model variant downgrade + region failover), 3) measure cost delta with batching + kv-cache.

Technical asks / POC plan (shorthand):
- Canary plan: start with model-variant 'open-m4-qa' (fp16) for 10% traffic for 48h, monitor P95 latency, token-cost, and quality on labeled eval set. If metrics stable -> 50% -> full.
- Fallback routing: primary -> dedicated na-central cluster (g4dn-like); fallback chain = dedicated-small-quant (4-bit) -> hosted_api eu-variant -> return 503 + degrade to cached responses.
- Region failover: na -> eu-west on sustained errors or infra outage. Failover triggers: p50 latency > 300ms AND error rate > 0.8% sustained for 5m.
- Rollback triggers: P95 latency increase > 30% from baseline OR quality regression (top-1 rerank accuracy drop >4%) OR error rate >1% for 10m.
- Metrics collection: token cost per 1k, P50/P95 latency, error rate, quality on eval prompt set (provided), KV cache hit ratio.

Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML), SOC2 report, audit logs exported to customer's SIEM, KMS integration for model inputs at rest, retention controls for logs. Data residency: primary NA, EU for EU customers; need data flow diagram for legal.

Commercials & blockers: cost sensitivity — wants 12 month committed plan if unit costs hit target. Asking Redwood for committed price tiers + burst pricing. Blocker: Legal DPA + internal infra diagram (security asks). SE (Liam) to run a dry-run canary and supply rollout playbook. CSM (Priya) will manage success metrics collection.
